episodes.synopsis: Mr. Villain is a high-ranking member of the Evil League, but when he's taking a day off from world conquest, he cares mostly about work-life balance. His days off are filled with shopping, pandas, and chance encounters with familiar faces.
episodes.title: Even We Need Some Healing, Too

episodes.synopsis: A new recruit learns that working for Mr. Villain can involve many surprises. Mr. Villain encounters a boy at the zoo whose interest in furry animals might rival even his own.
episodes.title: Earth Is Formidable Indeed

episodes.synopsis: Mr. Villain continues his gradual exploration of Earth culture, as he makes his way through a winter wonderland. They say monsters lurk in the cold depths of Earth's winter, unless of course it's all a matter of perspective.
episodes.title: The Fiends of Winter

episodes.synopsis: Spring has come, and that's the season for cherry blossoms and new additions to the workforce. But what little surprises can one discover that offer an escape from everyday drudgeries?
episodes.title: When Spring Comes to Town

episodes.synopsis: The Pink Ranger goes on a quest for a missing item, only to find help from an unlikely source. Mr. Villain cleans house and earns bonus points, then contemplates recruiting new allies in his struggle against humanity.
episodes.title: Magical Girl in Distress

episodes.synopsis: Summertime means beach trips and the Tanabata Star Festival, but alien invaders only know so much about Earth culture. Meanwhile, an envious coworker looks for a way to one-up our resident panda-loving villain.
episodes.title: Those Who Wish in Summer

episodes.synopsis: Rooney mentions reports of new panda sightings, so Mr. Villain spends his day off scouring an amusement park in search of his favorite furry friends. Along the way he learns more about the human culture he someday hopes to annihilate.
episodes.title: A Pandaful Weekend

episodes.synopsis: Shocking news from the zoo sets Mr. Villain up for a strange dream. And 'tis the season for mandarin orange art, Christmas presents, and some contentious internal debate about how to manage the Earth once the humans are gone.
episodes.title: Gifts in the Season of White

episodes.synopsis: As the Setsubun holiday season comes around, the mind grows impulsive with seemingly small desires. But what will all the pandas in one's life have to say when it comes to questionable decisions?
episodes.title: The Way of Desire

episodes.synopsis: Mr. Villain takes a day off from his day off, as the Rangers take the spotlight and reflect on how they came to be where they are today. It turns out that family dynamics can be tricky, even for superheroes.
episodes.title: Matters of Justice

episodes.synopsis: It's not easy for trees to talk to each other, when social mobility is limited at best. And everyone needs a helping hand sometimes, even misfit robots. Does Mr. Villain have the solutions?
episodes.title: When the Flowers Scatter
